title: ADA Subject — common keys
description: The two keys that nearly every record_subject carries, whatever its component type. Derived from metadata/subject_schemas/inferred: schema:description in 122 of the 133 inferred schemas, dataComponentType in 101. Neither is required HERE, because a fragment cannot know whether its consumer is one of the 11 types that omit description; the consuming type block adds them to `required` where the data supports it.

dataComponentType.description: The ADA component type this subject describes, e.g. STEMEDSCube. Matches the ada:componentType string used on a hasPart item in the published product, which is why the context maps it there.
